counties.notes: Fayette County (Lexington, pop. 322,000; consolidated city-county) Tax Parcels FeatureServer hosted on ArcGIS Online (LFUCG org). Fayette County is a merged urban county government, the Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government (LFUCG). Fields confirmed: PAN (numeric parcel account number), PARCEL_SUB, PARCEL_BLOCK, PARCEL_LOT, LRM_GEOM_DOC, RecordDate, LRM_GEOM_DOC_AREA/UNITS, PARCEL_TYPE, PARCEL_POLY_NAME, Owner1/2/3, Mailing_Address. Note: PARCEL_POLY_NAME may be null; PAN is the numeric parcel identifier. Mailing_Address is a single concatenated field. Verified 2026-05-15: Owner1 SMITH returns Lexington-area addresses (e.g., '3875 GEIST RD STE E469', '4951 E JOHN JOHN CT'). A separate Parcels FeatureServer exists at the same org but has no owner fields, Tax_Parcels is the correct service. Note: distinct from Jefferson County KY (Louisville, FIPS 21111) already in atlas.

counties.notes: Boone County, Kentucky (Florence, Burlington, Union; FIPS 21015). The county's tax parcel layer on its own ArcGIS Online organisation (Boone County Planning Commission, GIS Services Division), layer 0 'Tax Parcels': 55,275 parcels, maxRecordCount 2,000, pagination on, native State Plane feet (outSR=4326 works), CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). The parcel id is PIDN (format 999.99-99-999.99). The owner is PRCLOWNR1 (PRCLOWNR2 is the second owner; 55,229 of the rows carry one), the situs is SITEADD1 with CITYNAME and SITEZIP, and the owner mailing address is MAILADD1/MAILADD2 plus MAILPOST, MAILSTATE and MAILZIP. ASSESSVALU is a single assessed value with no land/improvement split, GMDACRE is the GIS acreage, and up to three sales ride on SALEDATE1-3/SALEPRICE1-3 (SALEDATE is a mm/dd/yyyy string). 14 rows carry the owner CONFIDENTIAL and most of those also carry a CONFIDENTIAL mailing address; the service description says nothing about why. The planning commission publishes this layer; the Boone County PVA is a separate office. The layer was last edited 2026-10-08. Verified 2026-10-09 by a count, field list, owner and mailing fill counts and a count of the sample query's predicate (488 rows).

counties.notes: Jefferson County, Kentucky (Louisville; FIPS 21111; the county is consolidated with Louisville Metro). 'Jefferson County KY Parcels', layer 1 of LojicSolutions/OpenDataPVA on the Louisville/Jefferson County Information Consortium (LOJIC) server: 293,248 parcel polygons, maxRecordCount 2,000, pagination on, State Plane feet (outSR=4326 works), CORS reflects the request Origin. The layer carries only PARCELID (293,217 rows), LRSN, PARCEL_TYPE and the polygon; its PIN column is empty on every row, and there is no owner, situs, mailing, value or sale column. Owner names are not published on this layer, so owner_name is recorded as not published. WHY THIS LAYER AND NOT METRO'S: Louisville Metro's New_AllParcels FeatureServer (services1.arcgis.com/79kfd2K6fskCAkyg, 289,963 rows) adds an Address and a property class, but its last edit is 2017-01-10 and its backing item (titled 'Commercial Parcels') was last modified in 2017, so it is a nine-year-old snapshot; LOJIC's layer is the consortium's own open-data parcel layer. The LojicData folder on the same server needs a token. No terms are published on the service. Verified 2026-10-09 by a count, field list and fill counts.
